name: Potion of Heroism

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 10 Temporary Hit Points and Bless (no Concentration) for 1 hour.
text: The blue liquid seethes and steams like it is at a boil. For 1 hour after you drink it, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points (gone once spent) and the benefit of the Bless spell without Concentration, so each attack roll and saving throw you make gains a 1d4 bonus.
